_comment: Hand-verified links from a wholesale SKU to a product on newsouthbotanicals.com,
for cases the public site does not expose a SKU we can match on.
The value is the public product's exact `name` in manifest.json.
Keep this list short and only add entries you have eyeballed -- fuzzy name
matching was tried and rejected here, because 'Mint Chocolate ... Original
Hemp Flower Extract (450MG)' and our 'Advanced Hemp Flower Extract 1400MG -
Mint Chocolate' are different products that a similarity score happily confuses.
The three parent SKUs below exist because product_variants.json folds pack
sizes into one product with variants, and moves the size-specific SKU off the
master onto the variants. Nsb::SiteImageImporter matches on the MASTER sku, so
without these the consolidated products stop matching the public site --
